metadata.title: On some rigidity results for high-dimensional confoliations
metadata.abstract: The main result is an obstruction to the presence of contact regions for c-symplectic confoliations in any odd ambient dimension. As a first application, we prove a 5-dimensional analogue (under stronger assumptions) of a Reeb stability theorem for confoliations in dimension 3 due to Eliashberg and Thurston. Refining work of the first author with Cardona, we further give two new notions of contact approximations of c-symplectic confoliations in any odd ambient dimension generalizing the 3-dimensional notion of Eliashberg-Thurston. As a second application of our main theorem, we then give an example, in any ambient odd dimension, of a c-symplectic (and in fact strong symplectic) foliation that cannot be contact approximated, in either of these two senses. This relies on the property, of independent interest, that contact structures approximating (in these senses) a weakly c-symplectic confoliation are also weakly fillable. The proofs of all these statements rely on pseudo-holomorphic curve theory. Lastly, we describe several natural classes of examples of these types of contact approximations of c-symplectic confoliations.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 给出任意奇维 c-symplectic confoliation 接触区域的障碍，并构造不能作两种意义接触近似的叶状结构。
analysis.breakthrough: 推广低维稳定性与近似概念，同时展示高维接触近似的限制。
analysis.limitations: 五维 Reeb 稳定性类比需更强假设。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者明确否认 AI 用于数学部分，仅披露最终拼写检查与解决 LaTeX 编译问题的命令生成。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者明确否认 AI 用于数学部分，仅披露最终拼写检查与解决 LaTeX 编译问题的命令生成。

analysis.priorityReason: 按几何相关性、结果新颖性、技术可复用性及摘要证据清晰度综合评分 66/100；重点在于推广低维稳定性与近似概念，同时展示高维接触近似的限制。
